current_task: Joint-6 six-class softmax with recovered ACS and OMI endpoints

ground_truth_and_split_provenance.note: Joint-6 evaluator uses explicit record_id joins and fail-closed duplicate/missing/coverage checks.

probability_and_threshold_semantics.note: ACS is marginalized and argmaxed; OMI=q2+q4; Youden threshold is selected on inner-validation and frozen on outer-test.

public_archive_safety.note: No checkpoint, raw ECG, patient table, record-level prediction, SSH credential or raw fairseq log is staged.

claims_and_external_validity.note: Joint-6 has no current independent external test, no multi-seed confirmation, and no same-protocol factorized baseline comparison. Fold t intervals are not patient-level bootstrap intervals.

known_modeling_exception.note: The singleton OTHER+OMI record is mapped to OTHER for Joint-6 training; raw OMI remains in primary OMI evaluation, but p_omi=q2+q4 cannot explicitly represent OTHER+OMI.

fine_tuning_provenance.note: The run labeled Partial FT reports 100% trainable parameters and must not be described as parameter-efficient partial tuning.
